_note: Which account a platform session is signed in as (src/browser/identity.ts, ACCT-C05). page is opened first; fetch is a same-origin account endpoint read with the session's cookies; emailField is a dot path into its JSON. A platform without page/fetch/emailField has no reader: every run on it is refused until a reader is added and checked live. liveVerified says whether the reader has been seen working against the real site.

claude.note: Same endpoint and field cc browser signin already uses to confirm the signed-in email (data/selectors/claude.json signIn.accountUrl / accountEmailField).

chatgpt.note: ChatGPT's session endpoint; not yet seen live by cc. If it yields no email every chatgpt run is refused (fail-closed), never allowed.

grok.note: No identity reader known for grok.com: every grok run is refused (ACCOUNT_NOT_AUTHORIZED) until one is probed live and added here.
